title: ArcticDB in-region probe record
description: data_collection/probes/arctic/{trading_day}.json (data-collector plan P-05, alpha-engine-config-I10748). Written by collectors/arctic_probe.py::run_probe as the final workload of the data-collection-eod and data-collection-morning schedules. Read by nousergon-data/data_gate (architecture.d/146 §4.1) as the sole ArcticDB-derived evidence source, since ArcticDB is unreadable from the laptop (alpha-engine-config-I9771). PRODUCER TEST: tests/test_arctic_probe.py. v1.

as_of_utc.description: UTC timestamp the probe ran, independent of trading_day.

trading_day.description: The trading-day axis key this record is filed under (dates.default_run_date() by default).

last_index_date.description: Max per-symbol date_range end across the library; null iff the library holds no symbols.

version_id.description: Always null today — ArcticDB versions are per-symbol, not per-library. Kept nullable for a future per-symbol probe variant.

read_ok.description: Always true in a written record: a library that failed to open/list/describe raises collectors.arctic_probe.ProbeError and the whole record is never written (no partial record) — see the module docstring.
